title: New Home Builder Warranties — Schedule of Programs and Coverage Terms
content:
Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties are offered in six programs. A registered builder enrolls a newly built home in one of them at the home's first sale, and each program sets how many years after the closing date each kind of coverage runs.

## Programs and the homes they accept

Every program accepts only new construction, sold at a final sale price of no more than 3000000.00 dollars, by a builder registered with Bridgewell. The programs differ in the home types they accept:

| Rank | Program | Home types accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | Single-family detached |
| 2 | Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | Single-family detached |
| 3 | Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | Single-family detached |
| 4 | Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | Townhome, condominium |
| 5 | Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | Single-family detached |
| 6 | Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | Single-family detached |

## Coverage terms, in years after the closing date

A figure of 0 means the program has no coverage of that kind.

| Program | Workmanship | Water penetration (as workmanship) | Distribution systems | Builder-installed appliances | Structural |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Structural-Only Ten-Year | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 1 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 10 |
| 1-2-10 with Appliances | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 10 |
| 1-2-10 Attached Home | 1 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 10 |
| 1-2-10 with Systems Extension | 1 | 1 | 4 | 0 | 10 |
| 2-4-10 Premier | 2 | 2 | 4 | 2 | 10 |

Workmanship coverage is the builder's obligation. Distribution systems are the plumbing, electrical and HVAC distribution systems. Structural defects are covered by Bridgewell.

## Passing to a later owner

| Program | Warranty passes automatically to a later owner of the home |
|---|---|
| Structural-Only Ten-Year | Yes |
| 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | Yes |
| 1-2-10 with Appliances | Yes |
| 1-2-10 Attached Home | Yes |
| 1-2-10 with Systems Extension | Yes |
| 2-4-10 Premier | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

**What do the three numbers in a program name stand for?** In the 1-2-10 programs workmanship runs 1 year, distribution systems 2 years and structural coverage 10 years; in the 2-4-10 Premier program they run 2, 4 and 10 years. The 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension departs from its name in one column: its distribution systems coverage runs 4 years.

**Which program can a townhome or condominium carry?** Only the Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty accepts those home types; the other five accept single-family detached homes.

**Hypothetical example.** A newly built single-family detached home sells for 3000000.00 dollars through a registered builder: the sale price is at the ceiling and the home is accepted by any of the five detached programs. Had it sold for 3000000.01 dollars, no program would accept it.
